text_block_list.text:
The "Mejiro Clan" showdown at the 
Takarazuka Kinen. In that fierce battle, 
Mejiro McQueen proved her "strength" and 
seized victory in her grasp.

The Takarazuka Kinen came to a close, 
surrounded by the roaring cheers of the 
crowd celebrating the fierce battle 
between the two.

And—after a fierce battle at the 
Takarazuka Kinen, Mejiro McQueen set a new 
goal. Namely, conquering the Autumn Tenno 
Sho.

Setting out to achieve the great feat of 
winning consecutive Spring and Autumn 
Tenno Sho titles, something no one in the 
Mejiro family had ever accomplished, she 
began her run.
